data.label: Pages
data.text:
Read Me: General explanations about how the sheet works

Main: The sheet itself. Unless you create other sheets, it should be the only one you use during play.

Class specific widgets: Some classes have abilities that other classes do not share, so the widgets for those abilities are not on the main page by default. Go to the Class specific widgets page, right-click the widgets that apply to your class, and select the "Move to sheet" option then "Main" to move them to the main sheet.

Core Data: contains the class data from the book "Umerican Survival Guide". You normally should not need to open this page, since it serves as a reference for the automations used on the other pages

Splat data: contains the class data from the books "Umerican Road Atlas" and "Umerica Unnatural". You normally should not need to open this page, since it serves as a reference for the automations used on the other pages

data.label: Page Main
data.text:
Many fields on the sheet are calculated automatically from the Data pages and the information entered in the sheet.



Info: the Species, Class, and Alignment fields are used to calculate your character's derived characteristics on the sheet.


Species:


Robot: The only chassis elements calculated automatically on the sheet are the base AC and the movement speed.

Characteristics: the value in the "Mod" column is calculated automatically from the "Val" column. Since an Umerica character's characteristics can be temporarily modified, the "Max" column can be used to note the permanent value of the characteristic. This lets you freely change the value in the "Val" column so that temporary changes are calculated automatically on the sheet.

Stats:
The Level, Shield, Armor Die, Fumble Die, and Speed Modifier fields are the only ones that are not calculated automatically


Shield: Using a shield has two mechanical effects, +1 AC and +1 fumble die. The AC bonus is calculated automatically, but the fumble die change is not.

Speed Modifier: This field is for speed modifiers that do not come from the character's species or class: the base speed of the species is included in the Speed field calculation, as is the Holy Roller speed modifier.

Health:
Maximum hit points are not calculated since they are determined with dice.
A Cyborg can replace this widget with the "Cyborg Health" widget found on the "Class specific widgets" page

Weapons:


Attack: The first 4 rows of the Attack column are calculated using the character's Strength (for melee weapons) and the other 4 rows are calculated using the character's Agility (for ranged weapons). Place your weapons accordingly in the table.

Atk Mod: The Atk Mod column is used to adjust the value of the Attack column with modifiers other than those from the class and the associated characteristic

data.label: Class specific Widgets
data.text:
To move a widget from this page to the Main page, right-click the widget and select the "Move to sheet" option -> Main


Cleric: The Cleric Spellcasting widget, the Spells widget, and the Lay on Hands widget can be added to the Main page.

Cyborg: The Cyborg Health widget can replace the Health widget on the Main page, and the Cyborg Reparations widget can be added to the sheet

Cyborg Health: the "Temp hp" value is considered separately from the rest of the hit points. Damage must be added to the "Meat damage" or "Frame damage" field depending on the result of the attack, and the matching hit points will be removed from the health bar. Only touch the health bar to change the maximum.

Cyborg Reparation: allows a quick calculation of the repair DC and repair cost for a full repair of the Frame damage (left) or a partial repair of the Frame damage (right)

Feral Urchin:

Feral Urchin (Nerd): the Nerd Skills widget can be added to the Main page

Feral Urchin (Wildchild): the Wild Rumpus widget can be added to the Main page. The field values are calculated automatically and represent the characteristics of the Feral Urchin's Wild Rumpus form.

Fossorian: No additional widget is needed

Gray: No additional widget is needed

Mutant: the "Mutant Features" widget can be added to the Main page

Petrol Head: The Petrol Head Features widget can be added to the Main page

Robot: No additional widget is needed

Scavenger: The Scavenger Skills widget can be added to the Main page. The modifiers include the class modifier and the associated characteristic

Technologist: The Technologist Skills widget can be added to the Main page. The modifiers include the class modifier based on alignment and the associated characteristic.

Warrior: The Warrior Features widget can be added to the Main page

Wizard: The Wizard Spellcasting and Spells widgets can be added to the Main page. The Wizard Spellcasting widget values include the modifiers associated with the character's Intelligence characteristic

Holy Roller: The Lay on Hands widget can be added to the Main page.

Hunter: The Hunter Skills widget can be added to the Main page. The modifiers include the class modifier and the modifier of the associated characteristic

Road Hawg: The Road Hawg Features widget can be added to the Main page

Psion: The Psionic Powers and Spells widgets can be added to the Main page

Psi-Mutant: The Psionic Powers and Spells widgets can be added to the Main page

Psylatan: The Psionic Powers and Spells widgets can be added to the Main page

Beastkin: No additional widget is needed

Shifter: No additional widget is needed
